note: Curated saved annotations with visible road-defect boxes. Examples come from different historical runs; model details and class IDs are recorded per source. These illustrations are not ground truth or an accuracy evaluation.

historical-phone.label: Historical application output
historical-phone.note: Saved labelled photographs and matching prediction sidecars. Numeric classes follow this historical run, checked against the visible labels; the exact checkpoint and run threshold are unavailable.

saved-map-export.label: Saved project map photograph
saved-map-export.note: Existing saved annotations retained. Raw inference coordinates and exact checkpoint are unavailable; only the visible defect class is transcribed.

current-app.label: Current application photo run
current-app.note: Saved application run with prediction sidecars and run metadata.

training-export.label: Saved training prediction export
training-export.note: Labelled export without an original photo or raw prediction sidecar. Visible labels are retained; no confidence or vector coordinates are invented.

run2-video-20261026.label: Run2 saved video detections
run2-video-20261026.note: Saved YOLO-rendered annotations and prediction sidecars. Class names for the included IDs were checked against the visible image labels; the separate density CSV uses a different class mapping and is not used here. The checkpoint hash is recorded only as an unverified expectation from the run metadata. Original and annotated JPEGs are copied unchanged.

run4-video-20261026.label: Run4 saved video detections
run4-video-20261026.note: Saved YOLO-rendered annotations and prediction sidecars. Included class IDs were checked against the rendered labels. The checkpoint hash is an unverified expectation from run metadata. Original and annotated JPEG bytes are preserved. Within a 2 metre GPS match radius, the owner selected these newer pairs to replace the corresponding Run2 gallery examples.

run2-photos-20261026-095926.label: Run2 photo batch, 26 October 2026
run2-photos-20261026-095926.note: All 39 saved annotations from this photo batch, matched by exact frame IDs to the unlabelled source PNGs. Class IDs were checked against the saved rendered labels. The expected model hash is unverified run metadata. The PNG originals and annotated JPEG files are copied unchanged. This is a later Run2 photo batch, distinct from the earlier Run2 video examples retained in the gallery.
